title: Example 3: JSON text fallback (as printed)

source.clause: §8 Example 3: text fallback (JSON over WebSocket text frame)
source.note: verbatim: copied exactly as the standard prints it, including the `...` that ends the content string.

notes: The payload ends in `...`, which is the standard's way of showing a truncated WAV file, not base64. Under §7.2 ("Binary data shall be base64-encoded") this cannot be decoded, so the expectation is a base64 error; 02-example-3-text-fallback-truncated-payload is the same message with the ellipsis removed. Conflict recorded rather than resolved.
